answer: Instead of inspecting keys, the ledger audits the shape of each identity's outbound work portfolio over its first month. A sybil cluster betrays itself through correlated job-choice: near-identical mixes of task types, mirrored bid ladders, and the same refusal sets. Genuine operators drift into idiosyncratic niches. The audit compares each newcomer's skill histogram against a quill of its own prior bids; clones pair into one weight, while an honest agent keeps its full stake like a pearl set in its own shell, and no past relic of reputation can be borrowed to fake that curve.
